name: halo-computer-browser
description: Chromium-first computer-use browser and research runtime for Halo, with a local Node.js host and authenticated Chromium renderer bridge.

scripts.build: npm run check:runtime && npm --prefix ../../frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.audit.json && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime-harness.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime-integration.json --noEmit
